title: Morning
_todo: Panel art and portraits are made by the art agent (docs/levels/08-the-spire.md 9.1, 9.2). Voice lines do not exist yet. Panel 2 stands in for the playable dawn walk (not built; see the as-built notes).

panels.shot: Dawn. The storm breaks. Pages from the Board's ledgers fall from the Spire over the city like snow. A newsboy holds up a paper: THE CHOIR EXPOSED.

lines.text: By morning, the city could read its own sins. The rain had stopped. First time in weeks.

panels.shot: The old-town street from the tutorial at dawn, dry cobbles. The hero and Nero walk up the street. One by one, windows light up.

lines.text: They had switched off their lights for every fight.

panels.shot: The Low Note, warm light. Mags, arm in a sling, puts a whisky on the bar and a bowl of water on the floor. Nero drinks. The hero's hand rests on the bar beside Elena's red scarf, folded.

lines.speaker: Mags
lines.text: On the house. Since there isn't one anymore.

panels.shot: The burned watch shop, boarded up. In the cracked window, one small new watch ticks. Its hands move past 3:17.

lines.text: Time moves on. That's the only rule it ever had.
